title: Voxel (2012)
description: I created a Voxel engine using LWJGL and Java. I started by constructing a 3D array of chunks (8x8x8 cubes each) and clustering 8x8x4 chunks on screen. Then I generated the materials, ground level, caves and biomes using 3D Perlin noise and a cellular automata method. Next, I calculated lighting per Voxel. To increase performance, I culled all hidden cubes and faces. Then I created a QEF file loader so that I could model my objects and levels with Qubicle.
